title: Ninth Pylon
summary: Horemheb used blocks from dismantled Aten temples inside this pylon.
orientation: Between the Eighth and Tenth Pylons.

claims.text: Horemheb used blocks from dismantled Aten temples inside this pylon.
The reused small sandstone blocks are known as talatat. A wall can conceal evidence older than its visible exterior.
Ramesses II added decoration to the gateway and walls between the Eighth and Ninth Pylons, including festival procession scenes.

caveats: Field access and demonstration viewpoints are unverified; this is an editorial research draft.
